card.name: Linking words before alpha-blocker drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as" in "such as", commas, "or", "and" or "of" that come right before an adrenergic-blocking or antihypertensive drug name like phentolamine, clonidine, guanethidine or prazosin.

modes.label: such as
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" introducing an example alpha-blocking or sympatholytic drug.
modes.example: alpha-adrenergic blocking drug (such<< as>> phentolamine mesylate)

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma, "or" or "and" in a list of adrenergic drugs, just before the next drug name.
modes.example: block the pharmacologic effects of guanethidine, clonidine,<< or>> similar agents

modes.label: Of before phentolamine
modes.description: The word "of" after injection, just before phentolamine is named.
modes.example: was treated with an IV injection<< of>> 20 mg of phentol

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens, which are mixed languages; the suppressed tokens are all forms of "money".
card.plain: It fires on little linking words right before a drug name like phentolamine or clonidine in lists of blood-pressure-lowering drugs.
